$schema: sidecar for DESIGN.md — mirrors frontend/src/app.css :root exactly; keep in sync

meta.world: ham-radio waterfall / spectrum scope instrument panel

signal.meaning: live/active only — exclusive, never used as permanent chrome or decoration

waiting.meaning: patient, scheduled, not alarming — the retry ladder's normal state

fail.meaning: terminal failure only — never used for waiting/backoff

focus.meaning: keyboard focus ring, never suppressed (hard accessibility requirement)

families.font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

typography.rule: mono = numbers/timestamps/state tags/UI chrome; sans = real content (song/artist/album)

sizesInUse.0.8125rem: secondary lines (artist byline, errors, countdown, detail rows)

space.note: space-7/space-8 defined but not yet consumed by any built component

motion.reducedMotion: all three durations zeroed globally under prefers-reduced-motion; every bespoke @keyframes literal-duration animation additionally needs its own override
